note: Authored transcript. Replayed verbatim; the tools below really run against the database, so the evidence is real even though the reasoning is canned.

turns.text: The issue names an accounts receivable control difference. I will read the reconciliation first, then the mapping of any account the engine attributes it to.
One line differs with no customer against it, and the engine attributes the whole difference to a single legacy account. I will look at how that account is mapped.
The account is a contra-asset mapped into a receivables control account. I will check the document-level control to see whether anything else contributes.

findings.hypothesis: Legacy account 1205 Allowance for Doubtful Accounts is a contra-asset mapped onto target 1200 Accounts Receivable. Its balance therefore joins the receivables control total while belonging to no customer, which is why the subledger differs with nothing assigned to a party.

evidence.claim: The receivables control differs on a line with no customer against it, and the engine attributes the whole difference to legacy account 1205.
Account 1205 is a contra-asset whose approved mapping points at target account 1200.

open_questions: Confirm with the customer that 1210 is the allowance account they intend to use in the new chart.
